result.summary: 本文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，用零样本、单样本和少样本设置评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，有时接近此前最先进的微调方法 [abstract]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract]。作者还系统研究了数据污染问题，并讨论了该发现及 GPT-3 的更广泛社会影响 [abstract][S1.p15]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：传统方法虽然架构与任务无关，但仍需要针对每个任务准备数千到数十万个样本的微调数据集 [S1.p2]。作者希望探索一条途径，使语言模型在训练时获得广泛技能，并在推理时仅通过自然语言指令和少量示例快速适应或识别任务 [S1.p6]。此前这类方法的结果远逊于微调，因此需要大幅改进才能成为实用的语言任务求解方法 [S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
typically requires fine-tuning on a dataset of thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples specific to that task
the model develops a broad set of skills and pattern recognition abilities at training time, and then uses those abilities at inference time to rapidly adapt to or recognize the desired task
this approach still achieves results far inferior to fine-tuning
Meta-learning clearly requires substantial improvement in order to be viable as a practical method of solving language tasks.

method.text: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估时，GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。少样本设置从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer, similar to the Sparse Transformer
we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。数据集被分为 9 类，涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成与定性任务 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染，开发工具测量其影响，并对部分数据集不报告结果或加星号标注 [S1.p15]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning” ... (b) “one-shot learning” ... and (c) “zero-shot” learning
we group the datasets into 9 categories representing roughly similar tasks
In Section 3.9, we invent some additional tasks designed especially to probe in-context learning abilities
we develop systematic tools to measure data contamination and quantify its distorting effects
we either do not report results on these datasets or we note them with an asterisk, depending on the severity

findings.text: GPT-3 在多个 NLP 数据集上取得较强表现，包括翻译、问答和完形填空，以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务，有时甚至接近此前最先进的微调方法 [abstract]。在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 少样本达到 86.4% 准确率，比此前最先进结果提高超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。在 TriviaQA 上，零样本结果已超过微调 T5-11B 14.2%，少样本结果进一步比单样本提高 3.2% [S3.SS2.p2]。然而，GPT-3 在部分任务上仍然表现不佳，如 ANLI、RACE 和 QuAC [S1.p13]。此外，GPT-3 能生成人类评估者难以与人类撰写文章区分的新闻样本 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks
sometimes even reaching competitiveness with prior state-of-the-art fine-tuning approaches
GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
The zero-shot result already outperforms the fine-tuned T5-11B by 14.2%
GPT-3’s few-shot result further improves performance another 3.2% beyond this.

we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
GPT-3 can generate samples of news articles which human evaluators have difficulty distinguishing from articles written by humans

limitations.text: 作者指出 GPT-3 存在若干局限：模型仅采用自回归架构，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能解释其在 WiC、ANLI 及部分阅读理解任务上的落后表现 [S5.p3]。另一个更根本的局限是，单纯扩大自监督预测模型可能最终触及预训练目标的极限，因为当前目标对每个 token 等权，缺乏重要性概念，且模型未扎根于视频或真实世界物理交互等其他经验领域 [S5.p4]。此外，GPT-3 在预训练阶段的样本效率仍然较差，其预训练所见文本远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学到的任务，这一点仍不明确 [S5.p6]。最后，GPT-3 规模的模型推理成本高且不便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。

evidence.quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
This could be a possible explanation for GPT-3’s lagging few-shot performance on a few of the tasks, such as WIC ... ANLI ... and several reading comprehension tasks (e.g. QuAC and RACE).
it may eventually run into (or could already be running into) the limits of the pretraining objective
Our current objective weights every token equally and lacks a notion of what is most important to predict and what is less important.
large pretrained language models are not grounded in other domains of experience, such as video or real-world physical interaction
Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form
